
### p1

#### THE HARBOR NIGHT LOG

The lantern keeper crossed the wet stone bridge before dawn and the cold evening wind from the quiet harbor kept him awake until sunrise came over the eastern piers. Gulls gathered along the rail.

> [floats] Fig. 3


### p2

##### DAILY TALLIES

Every skiff was counted at the north pier and the m00rings were checked twice by the warden before the tide turned and the lamps along the quay were trimmed low for the last watch of the night to begin.

### p3

#### MIDNIGHT CROSSING OF THE SOUND

The ferry slipped out past the breakwater while the deckhands coiled rope and the city lights dropped away behind the stern.

### p4

#### NIGHT WATCH 34

Two lanterns burned above the gate while patrol boats idled near the slipway until relief crews arrived promptly.

Harbor watchmen logged every vessel that passed the beacon before first light.
